_comment: Gold-set labelers (DECISIONS D4, decided 2026-09-08 by Vincent Chan). Slot a = Gabe Murphy, slot b = Reid Bolus (`profiles.full_name` is william.bolus — he goes by Reid, so search this table by email, not by first name), adjudicator = Vincent Chan. Each slot is an email or auth user id matched case-insensitively against `profiles`; all three resolve to distinct rows, so `assignSlots` reports mode `configured` with nothing unresolved and no third admin can take a slot by labelling first. The import script takes the same two values as --labeler-a / --labeler-b. This file and goldset-v1.manifest.json are imported at build time: editing either needs a rebuild and a redeploy to reach the page.
